title: Philip Preaches in Samaria
description: Philip travels to a city in Samaria and proclaims Christ. Many are healed, unclean spirits are driven out, and the people come to faith and are baptized. Even the sorcerer Simon, who had amazed the people with magic, comes to faith and is baptized. Peter and John are sent from Jerusalem and pray for the believers, who receive the Holy Spirit through the laying on of hands. Simon tries to buy this gift with money but is sharply rebuked by Peter and told to repent.

versions.title: Philip Preaches in Samaria
versions.description: The deacon Philip travels to Samaria and proclaims the gospel with great power. Many are healed and come to faith, including the sorcerer Simon, who is baptized. Peter and John come from Jerusalem to pray for the Holy Spirit to be given to the believers, and Simon tries to buy this gift with money but is sharply rebuked by Peter.
